parsed.headline: Claim denied: BGM testing frequency requirement not met.
parsed.explanation: This claim is denied because the record does not show that the beneficiary has been performing frequent (four or more times a day) blood glucose monitoring, as required by policy: "The beneficiary has been using a BGM and performing frequent (four or more times a day) testing; and,".
parsed.what_to_do: No action needed unless documentation can show four or more BGM tests per day.
